text:
Priya: Noticing a pattern: many postmortem action items linger. Proposal: small "closure nudge" service that pings owners and escalates after a timeout.
Jon: Love it. Keep noise low pls. Weekly summary + direct DM for overdue only.
Priya: Suggested SLAs: P0/P1 = 14d, P2 = 30d. Owner must ack within 48h or it's flagged.
Sara: Add related_incidents links in the PM template so the nudge can show recurrence matches.
Diego: For comms, weekly public summary in #incidents, owner DMs private. Escalation flow: no ack -> oncall lead, then manager.
AlertBot: Cron registered: /closure-nudge every Mon 09:00 UTC.
Priya: Minimal timeline snippet for PM:

postmortem_timeline:
- milestone: "RCA published"
  target_days: "2"
  owner: "<name>"
- milestone: "Actions assigned"
  target_days: "5"
  owner: "<name>"
- milestone: "Remediation review"
  target_days: "14"
  owner: "<name>"
- related_incidents: []
- recurrence_risk: "low|med|high"

Jon: Implementation: small Lambda that reads tracker sheet, groups overdue by owner, posts DM + summary thread. DM sample: "You have 2 overdue items from PM #6789: <link>. Please update by Fri or reply with ETA."
Sara: Also add IC roster reminders: runner pings the next IC 24h before their shift and posts current IC weekly.
Priya: Next steps: Jon+Sara build MVP runner and PM template by Friday; Diego to draft escalation policy; Priya will track metrics request.
Diego: I'll add metrics: % closed on time, mean time to close, reassign count.
Jon: I'll test recurrence detection with 4 past PMs.
AlertBot: Action created: "MVP closure-nudge" assigned to Jon, Sara; due in 7 days.
